items.title: Pay invoice for hearing aids (patient share)
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026. The 30-day period runs 'nach Rechnungsdatum', so under §187(1) BGB the day of the event (19.11.) is not counted; the period starts on 20.11.2026. Under §188(1) BGB a period of days ends with the expiry of its last day: start day + 29 further days = 19.12.2026, which is a Saturday (24.11.2026 is Tuesday; 19.12.2026 is 25 days later, 25 mod 7 = 4, Tuesday+4 = Saturday). Under §193 BGB, if the last day of a period for a declaration or performance falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it is replaced by the next working day. Monday 21.12.2026 is not a public holiday in NW, so the payment is due by 21.12.2026.
